questions.stem: A 4-year-old girl who has been experiencing vaginal bleeding is brought for evaluation by her worried mother. The girl’s medical history is unremarkable, with normal physical growth and appropriate developmental landmarks. She has had all the recommended immunizations. On visual examination of the perineum, bleeding and multiple cystic masses resembling grapes are seen at the introitus.
